title: Chelsea's 2008 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Chelsea against Man Utd in the 2008 Champions League final (21 May 2008), when they drew 1-1 and lost on penalties. The goalkeeper (Petr Cech) is left out.

notes.Salomon Kalou: Salomon Kalou came on as a substitute in the 2008 final, so he did not start.
notes.Nicolas Anelka: Nicolas Anelka came on as a substitute in the 2008 final, so he did not start.
notes.Belletti: Belletti came on as a substitute in the 2008 final, so he did not start.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
